verdict.rationale: Incremental rollout is a fair question for a serverless deploy platform, so the axis applies, but the pack documents no gradual or percentage-based rollout, version traffic splitting, or canary mechanism. The only related evidence covers rolling back to a previous version (cloudflare-docs-23, cloudflare-docs-52), which is an adjacent recovery control, not an incremental rollout, and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can roll out new deployments incrementally to reduce blast radius
